image_description: A close-up shot of two cats resting together. The primary subject in the foreground is a brown/grey tabby cat with distinct black stripes, looking towards the left with half-closed eyes. Behind it, partially obscured, is an orange/ginger cat curled up, appearing to be asleep. They are resting on a surface near a green upholstered chair or sofa.
